python3 -c "
import cv2
import numpy as np
import math

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0083.png')
# find legs bottoms
# Leg color
mask = (img[:, :, 0] > 70) & (img[:, :, 0] < 110) & (img[:, :, 1] > 70) & (img[:, :, 1] < 110) & (img[:, :, 2] > 70) & (img[:, :, 2] < 110)
pts = np.argwhere(mask)
pts_stool = pts[(pts[:, 1] > 230) & (pts[:, 1] < 300) & (pts[:, 0] > 300)]

# group into legs by u coordinate
legs = []
for u_min, u_max in [(235, 260), (265, 280), (280, 295)]:
    sub = pts_stool[(pts_stool[:, 1] >= u_min) & (pts_stool[:, 1] <= u_max)]
    if len(sub) > 0:
        v_bottom = np.max(sub[:, 0])
        u_center = np.mean(sub[sub[:, 0] == v_bottom, 1])
        legs.append((u_center, v_bottom))

print('Legs bottom (u, v):', legs)

# Let's project each leg bottom to world
cam_x, cam_y, theta_deg = 1.619, 2.957, 15.0
theta_rad = math.radians(theta_deg)

for u, v in legs:
    Z_c = 1.55 / ((v - 256.0) / 256.0)
    X_c = ((u - 256.0) / 256.0) * Z_c
    wx = cam_x + Z_c * math.sin(theta_rad) + X_c * math.cos(theta_rad)
    wy = cam_y + Z_c * math.cos(theta_rad) - X_c * math.sin(theta_rad)
    print(f'Leg at u={u:.1f}, v={v}: Z_c={Z_c:.3f}, X_c={X_c:.3f} -> world=({wx:.3f}, {wy:.3f})')
"
